description: AT-26 Xavante displayed at the Clube de Aeronáutica de Brasília. It wears the serial 4536, but the real FAB 4536 crashed at Fortaleza on 25 Nov 1987, so the marking is false (AeroFórum 2009); a Feb 2026 compilation suggests the airframe may actually be FAB 4475. Members' club - ask at reception.
